definition: [ פָּרַק ] verb tear apart, away (Late Hebrew remove (load, etc.), Pi`el separate, take to pieces ; Arabic split, divide ;; ᵑ7 פְּרַק especially redeem, rescue ; Syriac withdraw (intransitive), also remove, rescue ; Ethiopic : set free ); — Qal Perfect 2 masculine singular וּפָרַקְדָמתּ֫ Gen 27:40 Imperfect 3 masculine singular suffix וַיִּפְרְקֵנזּ Ps 136:24 Participle active פֹּרֵק Lam 5:8 ; Ps 7:3 tear away yoke from pff ( מֵעַל neck Gen 27:40 ( J ); snatck from ( מִן ) foes, = rescue (Aramaic) Lam 5:8 ; Ps 136:24 so absolute Ps 7:3 (prefixing (וְ)אֵין , ᵑ7 ᵑ6 Che Du We ), > Hup Bae and others snatch away as prey. Pi`el Imperfect 3 masculine singular יְפָרֵק Zech 11:16 he shall tear off their hoofs; Imperative masculine plural פָּֽרְקוּ Exod 32:2 ( E ) tear off the golden ear-tings; Participle מְפָרֵק 1Kgs 19:11 a great wind rending mountains (|| מְשַׁבֵּר ). Hithpa`el tear off (for, i.e. from, oneself Ges «GKC:54f»§ 54f ); Imperfect 3 masculine plural וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ Exod 32:3 ( E ), with accusative אֶתנִֿזְמֵי הַזָּהָב ; Imperative masculine plural הִתְפָּרָ֑קוּ v Exod 32:24 ( E ; object omitted); passive be broken off, Perfect 3 plural הִתְפָּֽרְקוּ Ezek 19:12 (branches).
